dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Heck yeah! Always! And especially now, since you suggested it and everything.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: But before that — is your throat dry? Course it is, so's mine. Lemme make some tea real quick...

choices.text: You have a very entertaining way of talking!

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Huh? Oh, heh... Sorry, I bet half of what I say goes right over your head, huh?

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: I must get it from my mom. She raised me, so all my habits come from her, including my turns of phrase.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: If I ever say something that you don't understand, or it goes down like a lead balloon, please stop me and demand that I explain what I mean in normal-person terms.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Really, I insist — it's no trouble. Besides, hang out with me enough and I'm sure you'll be speaking fluent Gaming-ese before long!

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Ah, and if we're drinking tea, we're gonna need some nibbles!

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Luckily, I brought a sizeable stash of Winter Melon Cakes with me. Here's some for you... and here's a bunch for all your other guests...

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Wait! I almost forgot to count what's-her-face! Li'l Chubbikins, the one by the entrance.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Oh, sorry, I just mean she's round and chubby. Has she always lived here? It seems like it.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Her name is Tubby. And yes, she was here even before me.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Ahh, okay, Tubby, Tubby... My bad.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Cool, cool... You seem to know all sorts of amazing people from all over the place.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Makes sense though. Everyone adores you — you're smart, talented, and there isn't a bad bone in your body.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: What's that? Me too? Hahaha, if you say so!

choices.text: Gonna brew one of your signature herbal teas?

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Oh, uh... Sorry to disappoint. I'm afraid all I have with me is this Single-Origin Yauwan from my hometown...

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: But, if you want, I can take a look around your garden and scrounge some infusable foliage and whatnot to put aside for drying.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Then, in the future, I can make herbal teas on demand for you — Oh, and everyone else here.
